issue: पीर परी पधारया — परी is unclear: read as filler with पधारया (the pīrs came). It could be परे ('from afar', the pīrs who came from Mecca) or पड़ी ('fell, happened').
our reading: In the thirteenth the pīrs came; you brought their bowls and accomplished their purpose.
alternatives: The pīrs came from afar; the pīrs' need arose.

issue: भक्त उजागर अभय वर दीन्हा — उजागर ('renowned, bright') read as describing the devotee; it could describe the boon (a shining boon) or be a verb sense (made the devotee renowned).
our reading: and gave your renowned devotee the boon of fearlessness.
alternatives: made his devotee renowned and gave him the boon of fearlessness; gave the devotee the bright boon of fearlessness.

issue: चिथड़ों का घोड़ा ही साया — साया read as 'was made to go, became rideable' (the glossary's sense; the cloth horse that carried the child Rāmdev). Not found in Platts.
our reading: even a horse made of rags was made fit to ride.
alternatives: the horse of rags flew (with him).
